message.content: Niamh reflects on Jaime Lannister's character arc and suggests that if Jaime had remained true to the lessons he learned from Brienne of Tarth, he could have ended up being a true protector of the realm rather than a character consumed by his loyalty to Cersei. According to Niamh, if Jaime had chosen to step away from Cersei, he would have been able to honor his growth and also ensure a safer future for everyone. This scenario would have allowed Jaime to embrace his new values and create a partnership with Brienne that could have inspired the common people and reshaped their legacy in a positive way. However, Niamh acknowledges that it is challenging to envision a scenario where Jaime could have made different choices, as his past and the toxic nature of his relationship with Cersei likely made it difficult for him to fully escape his past ties.
